description: This file implements a message queue interface using System V IPC mechanisms, including functions for generating queue keys, creating, sending, and receiving messages, and managing message queue lifecycle within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: SysVMessageQueue
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a System V message queue, managing its creation, destruction, sending, and receiving messages.

methods.name: GenerateQueueKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for the message queue based on a string input, using a hash function.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::SysVMessageQueue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message queue object with a message queue ID and auto-close flag.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::~SysVMessageQueue
methods.description: Destructor that removes the message queue if auto-close is enabled.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Create
methods.description: Creates or opens an existing message queue with a given name and auto-close option, returning a unique pointer to the queue object.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the queue, with an option for blocking or non-blocking operation.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Receive
methods.description: Receives a message from the queue, with support for message types and blocking/non-blocking modes.
